profile.name: RTL_PLD_MD
profile.rationale: Enable required precision landing during RTL recovery.

profile.name: LTEST_MODE
profile.rationale: Dock target is stationary relative to the home frame.

profile.name: PLD_HACC_RAD
profile.rationale: Begin descent once horizontal landing error is inside the landing accuracy target.

profile.name: PLD_BTOUT
profile.rationale: Abort landing-target tracking when the target is lost beyond the configured reacquire timeout.

profile.name: PLD_FAPPR_ALT
profile.rationale: Enter final approach near the range-assisted flare altitude.

profile.name: PLD_MAX_SRCH
profile.rationale: Allow bounded retries before falling back from required search behavior.
